## 7.1 Simulation conditions

- Physics: MuJoCo 3.13.0, time step 2.0 ms (controller rate 500 Hz), gravity 9.81 m/s^2.
- Robot: Yamaha YK-XG geometry, L1 = 142 mm, L2 = 116 mm, Z stroke 130 mm; J1 +-139.8 deg, J2 +-143.8 deg, J4 +-360 deg.
- Actuator limits (assumed): [40, 20, 50, 2] (N m, N m, N, N m); viscous friction B = [0.50, 0.30, 5.00, 0.02] (N m s/rad, N m s/rad, N s/m, N m s/rad).
- Trajectory sample period 10 ms; S-curve (quintic) time law unless stated.

Dynamic parameters (from the CAD model, in the DH link frames):

| link2 | {2} | 6.386 | (-65.4, -0.0, 195.1) | 2.077e-02, 3.589e-02, 2.182e-02 |
| link3_and_4 | {4} | 0.071 | (0.1, 0.2, 142.6) | 1.247e-04, 1.247e-04, 1.969e-06 |
